items.question: What minimum age does Dubai Cares set for volunteer supporters who are not accompanied by a parent or guardian?
items.gold: Supporters must be over 16 years of age; those under 16 are eligible only when accompanied by a parent or guardian.
items.fact: Dubai Cares volunteers must be over 16 unless accompanied

items.question: How much did the Sandooq Al Watan National Fund allocate for university research and development for the years 2017 to 2019?
items.fact: Sandooq Al Watan allocated AED 10-25 million for R&D 2017-2019
